name: Otter Tail County, MN
findings: Otter Tail County has 252 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Otter Tail County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Otter Tail County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
